title: Bias in Literature
skills: identify bias in literary and informational texts
analyze how perspective influences representation and meaning
distinguish evidence from opinion or partial interpretation
evaluate how bias affects a reader's understanding of a text
alignment_note: Introduces bias in literature and examines how perspective, assumptions, and selective representation can shape meaning and reader interpretation. Supports critical reading, point-of-view analysis, source awareness, and evidence-based literary analysis across high school English courses.
